## TenderlyRpcConfig interface

Credentials for the Tenderly Node Web3 Gateway. The `rpcUrl` is the chain-specific gateway URL with the access key embedded in the path, e.g. `https://mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co/{ACCESS_KEY}`<!-- -->.
